preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 105, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it's possible to obtain 24, or 'NO' if it's not.
If the output is 'YES', then there are exactly n - 1 lines of operations, each describing a single operation.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(c) <= 10^18 for a, op, b, c in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation's result c must have an absolute value less than or equal to 10^18.
The result of the last operation must be exactly 24.
